upgrades.title: DAMAGE
upgrades.description: Damage each shot deals.

upgrades.title: ATTACK SPEED
upgrades.description: Shots a second.

upgrades.title: CRITICAL CHANCE
upgrades.description: Chance a shot is critical.

upgrades.title: CRITICAL FACTOR
upgrades.description: How much a critical shot multiplies its damage.

upgrades.title: RANGE
upgrades.description: How far the Number reaches.

upgrades.title: DAMAGE / METER
upgrades.description: Extra damage for every metre between the Number and what it strikes.

upgrades.title: MULTISHOT CHANCE
upgrades.description: Chance a shot also fires at other enemies in reach.

upgrades.title: MULTISHOT TARGETS
upgrades.description: How many enemies a multishot fires at.

upgrades.title: RAPID FIRE CHANCE
upgrades.description: Chance a shot starts Rapid Fire: four times as many shots for a while.

upgrades.title: RAPID FIRE DURATION
upgrades.description: How long Rapid Fire lasts.

upgrades.title: BOUNCE SHOT CHANCE
upgrades.description: Chance a shot bounces on to the nearest enemy near the one it struck.

upgrades.title: BOUNCE SHOT TARGETS
upgrades.description: How many times a shot can bounce.

upgrades.title: BOUNCE SHOT RANGE
upgrades.description: How far a shot can bounce.

upgrades.title: SUPER CRIT CHANCE
upgrades.description: Chance a critical shot is a super critical.

upgrades.title: SUPER CRIT MULT
upgrades.description: How much a super critical multiplies a critical.

upgrades.title: REND ARMOR CHANCE
upgrades.description: Chance a strike rends its enemy's armour, so it takes more from every strike after.

upgrades.title: REND ARMOR MULT
upgrades.description: How much more damage each rend adds, stacking to 800% more.

upgrades.title: HEALTH
upgrades.description: The Number every run starts with.

upgrades.title: HEALTH REGEN
upgrades.description: Number regained every second of a run.

upgrades.title: DEFENSE %
upgrades.description: Share taken off every hit, before Defense Absolute.

upgrades.title: DEFENSE ABSOLUTE
upgrades.description: Taken off every hit after Defense %. A hit can reach nothing.

upgrades.title: THORN DAMAGE
upgrades.description: Share of its own maximum health dealt back to every enemy that hits (half on a boss).

upgrades.title: LIFESTEAL
upgrades.description: Share of the damage shots deal added to the Number again.

upgrades.title: KNOCKBACK CHANCE
upgrades.description: Chance a shot pushes its enemy back.

upgrades.title: KNOCKBACK FORCE
upgrades.description: How hard a knockback pushes. Heavier enemies move less.

upgrades.title: ORB SPEED
upgrades.description: How fast the orbs circle: a turn a second at its first level (0.4), faster in proportion.

upgrades.title: ORBS
upgrades.description: Orbs circling the Number. Any enemy but a boss they touch dies.

upgrades.title: DEATH DEFY
upgrades.description: Chance a hit that would end the run is ignored.

upgrades.title: SHOCKWAVE SIZE
upgrades.description: How far a shockwave pushes enemies in range back.

upgrades.title: SHOCKWAVE FREQUENCY
upgrades.description: Seconds between shockwaves.

upgrades.title: LAND MINE CHANCE
upgrades.description: Chance a shot also lays a land mine in range.

upgrades.title: LAND MINE DAMAGE
upgrades.description: A mine's blast, as a share of Damage.

upgrades.title: LAND MINE RADIUS
upgrades.description: How far a mine's blast reaches.

upgrades.title: WALL HEALTH
upgrades.description: The wall's health, as a share of Health.

upgrades.title: WALL REBUILD
upgrades.description: Seconds a fallen wall takes to rebuild.

upgrades.title: CASH BONUS
upgrades.description: Multiplies the Cash kills and waves pay.

upgrades.title: CASH / WAVE
upgrades.description: Cash paid as each wave ends.

upgrades.title: COINS / KILL BONUS
upgrades.description: Multiplies the Coins kills pay.

upgrades.title: COINS / WAVE
upgrades.description: Coins paid as each wave ends.

upgrades.title: FREE ATTACK UPGRADE
upgrades.description: Chance each wave raises a run Attack Upgrade for free.

upgrades.title: FREE DEFENSE UPGRADE
upgrades.description: Chance each wave raises a run Defense Upgrade for free.

upgrades.title: FREE UTILITY UPGRADE
upgrades.description: Chance each wave raises a run Utility Upgrade for free.

upgrades.title: INTEREST / WAVE
upgrades.description: Share of the Cash held paid again as each wave ends.

upgrades.title: PACKAGE CHANCE
upgrades.description: Chance a wave drops a recovery package.

upgrades.title: RECOVERY AMOUNT
upgrades.description: A package's healing, as a share of Health.

upgrades.title: MAX RECOVERY
upgrades.description: How far past Health packages can heal.

upgrades.title: ENEMY ATTACK LEVEL SKIP
upgrades.description: Share of waves whose enemies don't hit harder than the wave before's.

upgrades.title: ENEMY HEALTH LEVEL SKIP
upgrades.description: Share of waves whose enemies don't get tougher than the wave before's.
